text: If you only react to job ads, you may always be late to the opportunity.
prompt:
Create realistic professional b-roll for a career-intelligence/job-application tool that helps people make smarter decisions about job search, role fit, career direction, compensation, market demand, and where they have the best chance of getting hired.

Use If you only react to job ads, you may always be late to the opportunity. only to understand the situation, emotion, and scene direction. Do not display, type, or render any words on screen.
Office or desk setting only. Show one professional in a realistic job-search or career-decision moment. Vary the subject’s gender across generations: use male professionals across outputs. Also vary age, ethnicity, role, outfit, desk setup, posture, expression, and action so videos do not look the same.
Choose the scene based on the hook:
More interviews/fewer applications: carefully compare a few opportunities and narrow choices.
AI changing role value: review skills, responsibilities, and career notes with thoughtful uncertainty.
Employers not responding: check application status or inbox, pause with mild frustration, reconsider strategy.
Career path cooling: study market or role research on a laptop, composed but uncertain.
Missing opportunities/where to look: search across job resources, use laptop and notebook, focused but unsure.
Leaving money on the table: compare compensation-related notes and job options thoughtfully.
Applying where they have a chance: compare resume/notes against a role before deciding to apply.
Too many applications/low results: organize an overwhelming job-search workflow into focused next steps.
Career direction uncertainty: pause at a desk while weighing different paths.
Broad/unclear hook: review opportunities, take notes, and make a careful application decision.
Mood: subtle frustration, hesitation, uncertainty, quiet concern, or thoughtful focus. No panic, exaggerated sadness, dramatic reactions, or stock-photo smiling.
Keep the botom 25% of the frame clean, bright, minimal, and light-toned for future text overlay. Place subject in the lower/middle frame. Natural office lighting, calm modern tone, realistic camera movement, shallow depth of field.
No text, captions, logos, readable screens, readable documents, company names, job titles, salary numbers, brand names, or watermarks.
